Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1401
Claimant:
Perry Wilson
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2023-02-10
Claim opened for a left-turn collision at an intersection with a reported whiplash injury. The insured's driver is listed on
the policy, and the claimant is represented by counsel, so all contact will be routed thorugh the attorney's office.
2023-03-25
Police report and two statements confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact. No independent
witnesses have come forward to describe how the clolision happened.
2023-04-08
Photos from the scene and the repair shop show damage consistent with the impact described by both drivers.
Nothing in the file points to earlier damage on the vehicle, and nothing suggests the damage predates the policy's
coverage start.
2023-04-24
Recorded call with the claimant's attorney. The client's account of the turn and the impact matches what was told at
first notice, with no changes in the details.
2023-06-01
Medical records received for the initial emergency visit. The diagnosis of whiplash is plausible for a rear-quarter
impact at this speed, and no earlier treatment to the neck or upper back appears in the records.
2023-06-06
Reviewed the prior claims history and the claimant's medical history with the claimant's consent. No earlier injury to
the same body area is on file.
2023-07-18
Physical therapy notes received. Treatemnt followed a usual course for this type of injury, with visits tapering off as
the claimant's range of motion improved.
2023-07-25
Spoke again with the claimant's attorney to confirm the remaining treatment schedule. The claimant has been
consistent about symptoms and history in every conversation so far.
2023-08-31
Reviewed the repair estimate against the photos and the impact description. The damage pattern matches the
reported collision, and the repair scope is in line with the vehicle's make and model.
2023-09-14
Final review completed. The reported injury, treatment course, and vehicle damage all line up with the described loss,
and the file is ready for settlement evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
